pose: Full body side profile. A bull-shaped Carnotaurus with a short, blunt snout and two prominent, rounded horns above its eyes. It has very tiny, vestigial arms and a muscular body. It is standing with a gentle, curious tilt of the head. A large beetle is perched on one of its blunt horns. Friendly, soulful eyes and a smirk. Skin has a pebbled, leathery texture with warm orange tones. Standard three-toed feet with blunt nails. 1:1 square framing.
